items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Elizabeth Staton had a wind-up Victrola with Earl Hines and...oh, a lot of other people. I listened to that for a while.

ctx.x: Elizabeth Staton, it was. Not Mariana Staton. Elizabeth.
